system.description:
Usage worn around the wrist or neck.

The red thread appears fragile enough to break with a fingernail. Nobody has ever successfully cut one while its wearer was dying.

Activate R; Trigger You die

Frequency 1/day

The thread immediately casts Anchor the Departing Soul upon you with a duration of 24 hours.

On the sheet: Anchor the Departing Soul is held as an innate spell (1/day, 24 hours): the thread casts it on you when you die — cast it then. The trigger is the table's.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.

abilities.label: Thread of the Returning Soul
abilities.note: cast on you the moment you die — the thread's reaction, 1/day
